description: List the test suites in the connected product — id, name, type (Manual/Automation, where the provider has a suite-level type — SimplifyQA does, Walnut doesn't), and number of test cases. Use suite_get to read one with its ordered test cases, or suite_run to execute one. Requires a live connection (qa_connect). Read-only and product-neutral. When presenting this as a table, label the count column "Number of testcases", not "Members".
name: suite_list
title: List test suites
